component.name: Frostnotes
component.summary: Plain markdown notes on your own computer

description.p: Frostnotes is a notes app in the spirit of Obsidian. Notes are plain markdown files with YAML frontmatter, in a folder you own.

A background service inside the app, notesd, watches your vaults, keeps a search index with links, backlinks, tags and properties, and never writes over an edit it has not seen. Frostnotes works on its own: it needs no account, server or other app.
Sync is optional and built in. When you join a vault to a hub that you host yourself, such as one in lodge, each device keeps its own copy and concurrent edits merge without conflict copies.

The editor shows markdown as you type. Obsidian vaults open as they are, with wikilinks, embeds, tags, callouts and properties. The notesctl command and an MCP server give scripts and agents the same access.
